jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager - Cell Discovery
jobs.description:
United States, Durham (North Carolina)

Senior Marketing Manager – Cell Discovery

Location:
This position is based in our Durham, NC, Walkersville, MD or Boston, MA office. The typical work schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST.

What You Will Get

The full-time base annual salary for this position is expected to range between $132,100 to $148,650. In addition, below you will find a comprehensive summary of the benefits package we offer:

Performance-related bonus.
Medical, dental and vision insurance.
401(k) matching plan.
Life insurance, as well as short-term and long-term disability insurance.
Employee assistance programs.
Paid time off (PTO).

Compensation for this role will be determined by the candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, and relevant knowledge.

What Will You Do

At Lonza, we are seeking a scientifically driven and results-oriented Senior Marketing Manager, Cell Discovery to lead the execution of strategic marketing initiatives that accelerate demand generation, customer engagement, and portfolio growth across our life sciences business.

In this role, you will combine your scientific expertise with modern marketing strategies to translate complex technical concepts into compelling customer experiences and measurable business results. You will collaborate closely with global cross-functional teams, including Sales, Market Development, R&D, Digital Marketing, and Marketing Communications, to deliver impactful campaigns that support Lonza's growth objectives.

Develop and execute integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns aligned with strategic business priorities and portfolio growth objectives.
Plan and coordinate digital, content, email, webinar, social media, and event marketing initiatives.
Manage campaign timelines, budgets, deliverables, and performance metrics to ensure successful execution.
Partner with Commercial, Portfolio Management, Market Development, Scientific, and Regional Marketing teams to drive campaign effectiveness.
Map and optimize customer journeys to ensure marketing programs address customer needs and support business goals.
Leverage marketing automation, CRM platforms, SEO/SEM, analytics tools, content management systems, and other technologies to improve campaign performance.
Optimize digital experiences, including landing pages, email campaigns, website content, and paid media initiatives to drive conversion and engagement.
Translate complex scientific and technical concepts into compelling customer-facing messaging and high-value marketing content.
Support the development of webinars, scientific publications, application notes, white papers, customer success stories, presentations, and digital campaigns.
Collaborate with subject matter experts to ensure scientific accuracy and technical credibility across marketing materials.
Analyze campaign performance using defined KPIs and business metrics, providing actionable recommendations that improve marketing ROI.
Utilize customer insights, market trends, and digital analytics to continuously enhance campaign effectiveness.
Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across a global matrix organization while effectively managing multiple projects and priorities.
Ensure compliance with applicable safety, FDA, and ISO 9001 requirements.
Perform other duties as assigned.

What We Are Looking For

Master's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, or a related scientific discipline required; PhD preferred.
Strong scientific understanding of drug discovery workflows, cell biology, cell culture applications, and related life science technologies.
Minimum of 5 years of marketing experience within life sciences, biotechnology, cell and gene therapy, laboratory technologies, bioprocessing, or related markets.
Proven success developing and executing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns.
Experience translating complex scientific concepts into customer-focused value propositions and marketing strategies.
Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce, Eloqua, Pardot, or similar tools.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing, including email marketing, content marketing, social media, SEO, paid media, and marketing analytics.
Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and deliver actionable marketing insights.
Experience developing high-value content in partnership with Marketing Communications teams.
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills within a global, matrixed organization.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to rapidly adopt new digital tools and AI-enabled technologies.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while driving both personal and business objectives.
Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.title: Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Brassica + Northstar Restaurant Group is seeking an experienced Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager to lead the day-to-day execution and growth of our social media channels and online presence.

As Brassica expands into new markets, you will play a central role in building brand awareness, reaching new guests and strengthening engagement with our existing communities.

We're seeking a hands-on Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager to own and grow Brassica's digital presence across multiple markets. This role combines creative content production, organic social media management and independently executed paid advertising campaigns to build brand awareness, attract new guests and drive measurable business results. This is an execution-focused position for someone who enjoys doing the work, not simply directing it.

Core Responsibilities at Brassica + Northstar Restaurant Group

Own and grow Brassica's digital presence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Google, Yelp and emerging platforms, ensuring consistent brand identity and meaningful audience engagement.
Develop and execute multi-channel content strategies and calendars aligned with brand priorities, creating, shooting, editing and publishing compelling photography, short-form video and written content.
Independently plan, launch, manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google and TikTok, including budget management, audience targeting, creative testing and performance optimization.
Strengthen local search visibility through SEO, AI search optimization and platform management, positioning Brassica prominently in relevant food and restaurant searches across our markets.
Develop and execute geographically targeted organic and paid campaigns that drive brand awareness, first-time visits, repeat traffic, promotions and hiring.
Lead digital marketing efforts for new restaurant openings and market launches, including coordinated campaigns, local partnerships and in-person activations.
Monitor audience conversations, emerging trends and market insights to identify opportunities for engagement, content development and improved performance.
Establish, track and report meaningful KPIs, using data to refine strategies and connect marketing investments to measurable business objectives.
Collaborate with internal teams, restaurant operators, content creators and external PR partners to coordinate initiatives and maximize impact across markets.

Qualifications

3 to 5 years of hands-on experience managing social media and paid digital advertising for consumer-facing brands, including direct experience supporting brand expansion and launching marketing initiatives in new geographic markets.
Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, including campaign setup, targeting, budgeting, optimization and reporting.
Proven ability to independently produce compelling social media content, and experience with content creation, editing and social media management tools.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate campaign results into clear insights.
Excellent writing, organizational and communication skills.
Sound judgment, initiative and confidence making day-to-day marketing decisions without extensive oversight.
Experience in restaurants, hospitality, retail or other multi-location consumer businesses is preferred.
Ability to travel to restaurant locations and events as needed to capture content and support social media initiatives.
45+ hours per week (willingness to go above and beyond when necessary); be an exceptional manager of your time. Eager to produce high quality work with a strong sense of urgency.

Compensation will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Our comprehensive benefits package includes health, vision and dental insurance, 401k with company match, HSA, paid vacations + sabbaticals, complimentary and discounted meals, short and long-term disability, paid parental leave, and an active lifestyle benefit.

jobs.description:
Tao Group Hospitality offers competitive benefits for all full-time team members such as:

Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

401(k) Retirement Program with Employer Matcha

Life and Disability Insurance Plans

Ancillary Insurance Plans

Fertility & Family Forming Support and Resources

Employee Discounts

Time off and much more!

The Senior Manager, Marketing is responsible for developing, executing and analyzing venue-based marketing, nightlife programming and event strategies that align with the organization’s overall objectives, brand standards and financial goals. The Senior Manager, Marketing will be accountable for leading the development and execution of the venue’s annual marketing and event program, including innovative programming ideas, talent recommendations, marketing partnerships, promotional activities, advertising strategies, VIP Host engagement, social media and public relations coordination. This position will lead the execution of events and marketing programs on-site and serve as a strategic partner to Venue Operations and Executive Management.

The Senior Manager, Marketing will be highly creative, commercially focused and knowledgeable of the Las Vegas nightlife market, identifying opportunities to drive attendance, increase customer spend, strengthen guest loyalty and develop new sources of business. The Senior Manager, Marketing will have ownership of the venue’s brand positioning and market presence, including monitoring and responding to competitor programming, trends and consumer behavior.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE POSITION INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

Create and execute strategic events and nightlife programming based upon the overall Las Vegas calendar, venue history, business needs, target audience and revenue opportunities
Lead the development and execution of annual venue marketing plans in partnership with the Director of Marketing and Venue Leadership
Develop innovative marketing strategies and programming designed to increase attendance, customer spend, repeat visitation and overall venue profitability
Approve advertising, promotional and marketing collateral to ensure alignment with brand standards and strategic objectives
Analyze post-event qualitative and quantitative data, including attendance, revenue, spend and campaign performance, and provide actionable recommendations
Recommend talent and oversee the talent marketing process in partnership with the appropriate internal teams
Manage venue marketing budgets, invoices and financial tracking to ensure effective allocation of resources
Develop and manage client and corporate relationships by engaging organizations attending conferences and identifying opportunities to market the venue to local, national and international businesses
Work closely with the Sponsorship team to leverage and maximize the Company’s sponsorship capabilities and create incremental value for the venue
Work closely with media partners to leverage and maximize event activation opportunities, media exposure and value-added partnerships
Closely monitor competitor programming, venue activities, market trends and consumer behavior to identify opportunities and maintain a competitive position within the Las Vegas nightlife market
Maintain accurate event information and marketing details on event master worksheets, including Event Overviews and One Sheets
Develop event advertising and promotional needs and provide direction to the Marketing Coordinator for execution
Liaise with internal and external Promotions teams, communicate promotional rules and ensure marketing initiatives are effectively executed across all applicable channels
Liaise with VIP Services and Executive Management to maximize pricing, yielding and guest spend opportunities
Own and coordinate event communications across Executive Management, Public Relations, Advertising, Promotions, Social Media, Sponsorships, Clients and Operations
Communicate with select artist management and artists, providing marketing collateral, event information and support as needed
Manage the marketing design process through Asana in partnership with the Design team and ensure creative deliverables meet strategic objectives and deadlines
Lead and oversee event-day marketing execution, ensuring all activations, promotions, branding and guest-facing initiatives are executed successfully
Develop new sources of customers and business through professional networking, strategic partnerships, local business relationships and complementary brand collaborations
Lead the tactical execution of venue brand strategies and ensure consistency across all guest touchpoints
Lead the development of new event and nightlife brands and oversee pre-, during- and post-launch marketing strategies and activities
Conduct market research, including customer insights, competitor analysis and market positioning, to inform venue programming and marketing strategy
Lead re-branding and re-positioning efforts when needed and ensure consistent execution of brand standards
Support Private Events and Guest Services by overseeing marketing assets, collateral and promotional needs
Develop and oversee branded guest experiences that support the venue’s positioning and enhance the overall customer journey
Partner closely with Venue Operations, VIP Services, Entertainment, Promotions, Public Relations, Social Media and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and successful execution of marketing initiatives
Provide leadership, direction and mentorship to Marketing team members and support the development of a high-performing venue marketing team
Assist and/or complete additional tasks as assigned

EDUCATION/WORKING KNOWLEDGE:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, Business or similar discipline
Minimum of five to seven (5-7) years of nightlife, entertainment, hospitality or venue-based marketing experience, with a proven track record of strategic, financial and creative marketing success
Proven experience developing and executing marketing strategies for high-volume nightlife, entertainment or hospitality venues
Strong understanding of the Las Vegas nightlife market, including competitors, consumer trends, talent, media, partnerships and promotional channels
Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, analyze financial and event performance and identify opportunities to drive revenue
Strong leadership, communication, relationship-building and project management skills
Proficient in Windows Microsoft Office, POS Systems, Asana, Oracle knowledge preferred
21+ years of age

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
About ThredUp

ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry.

Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022.

How You Will Make An Impact

ThredUp is looking for a talented Growth Marketing Associate to join our growth marketing team as we continue to acquire and retain customers efficiently and at scale. This person has some experience with paid search marketing, wants to grow into a paid search expert as well as other paid media, and will work in partnership with the Growth Marketing team on channel execution and success. This role interacts extensively across Marketing, Creative, Engineering, Finance, and Product teams. Their input will help shape key business decisions and their efforts will drive new customer acquisition and shape the strategy of the growth function at ThredUp. We are seeking a smart, talented and creative individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment to help us inspire a new generation to think secondhand first.

In This Role You’ll Get To

Support strategy and execution across various paid search channels (Google Ads, Bing Ads) consisting of (but not limited to):
Campaign targeting, bidding, budget and keyword optimization in alignment with channel KPIs
Execute continuous testing across ad copy, landing pages, bid strategies, and creative assets to improve performance
Cross-functional collaboration with creative, merchandising, strategy teams on brief creation/execution
Support and strengthen partnerships with ad platforms and vendors
Help manage and optimize product feeds to drive efficiency for Google Shopping and PMax campaigns
Analyze and contribute to daily, weekly, monthly, and ad hoc channel reporting
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics teams to enhance our Ad Technology for campaign optimization
Make strategic recommendations around best practices and learnings from channel performance
Integrate AI Skills and Agents in how we analyze and optimize our campaigns
Stay up-to-date on upcoming industry trends

What We’re Looking For

2+ years of work experience in performance marketing, e-commerce, or other quantitative/data-driven fields
2+ years of hands-on work experience with Google Ads
Experience working in Claude Cowork or other AI interface
Versatile and able to work in a fast-paced environment
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
The ability to make data-driven decisions that add value to the customer experience
BA/BS in quantitative fields or marketing

At ThredUp, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. This role pays between $90,000 and $100,000 per year, and your actual base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

What We Offer

4-day work week, with Fridays off
Hybrid work environment: 3 days in the office and 1 day remote each week
Competitive salary (we leverage market data)
Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock and are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards
Employee stock purchase plan
Flexible PTO (take the time you need) + 13 company holidays
Paid Sabbatical after 3 years of full time employment
Generous paid parental leave for new mothers and fathers
Medical, dental, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance offered
We live by our Core Values of Transparency, SpeakingUP, Thinking Big, Infinite Learning, Influencing Outcomes & Seeking the Truth

We believe diversity, inclusion and belonging is key for our team

At ThredUp, our mission has been built on extending the lives of millions of unique clothing items. Much like our inventory, we are proud to have fostered a workplace that is one-of-a-kind. As a company focused on diversity, inclusion and belonging, we are committed to ensuring our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work every day. A unique perspective is critical to solving complex problems and inspiring a new generation to think secondhand first. Be you.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced digital marketing professional with the ability to translate strategies into business results while enhancing the member experience?

Do you have a proven track record of turning member data into targeted, personalized campaigns?

Would you like to work at a multi-faceted, dynamic organization that thrives on teamwork and collaboration?

If so, we’d love to talk with you about Monterra Credit Union’s Digital Marketing Lead Position!

Located in the heart of the Bay Area, Monterra Credit Union is a community-centric and growth-oriented financial institution. We invest in the success of people and our community by giving back, making things easier, and committing ourselves to our members’ potential. Diversity, equity and inclusion are critical to our success, and we value the varied backgrounds and experiences that everyone brings to our organization. If you value collaboration, forward-thinking, and giving back, this just might be the place for you.

SALARY & BENEFITS

Monterra Credit Union reflects the value placed on employees by providing an excellent salary and benefits package:
Starting pay of $50.48 - $57.69 per hour depending on experience
Semi-annual bonuses for meeting key financial and operational goals
Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Long-Term Disability insurances
401(k) including generous matching contributions
Discounts on financial products and services, including mortgage and auto loans
Paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and much more!

This position is based on-site at our Corporate Office in Redwood City, CA. Following the successful completion of meeting performance expectations, you may request a hybrid work arrangement of up to two remote days per week, subject to approval from your supervisor.

POSITION SUMMARY

As a key member of Monterra Credit Union’s Marketing team, the Digital Marketing Lead owns and drives the end-to-end digital marketing strategy to accelerate member acquisition, product adoption, engagement, and retention across deposit, loan, and ancillary products and services. This role is central to advancing Monterra’s digital readiness by maximizing the impact of owned digital channels through data-driven decision-making, personalization, and continuous optimization to deliver measurable business results and enhanced member experience.

The Digital Marketing Lead oversees digital channel strategy and performance across the website, mobile app, email, text messaging, and digital media. Partnering closely with marketing team members, internal stakeholders, and agency partners, this role translates product strategies and value propositions into integrated, high-performing digital campaigns. As the digital subject matter expert, the Lead ensures effective use of marketing technology investments through testing, analytics, and performance refinement, and serves as a trusted advisor and “go-to” resource for digital marketing best practices, innovation, and execution.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Own and lead the end‑to‑end digital marketing strategy across all owned digital channels, including digital and social media platforms, SEO, the public website, email, text messaging, online banking, and the mobile app, while also supporting digital media optimization in collaboration with marketing leadership and agency partner.
Define digital channel goals, performance benchmarks, and optimization roadmaps to drive brand awareness, member acquisition, retention, and cross‑sell.

Leverage member and digital banking data to develop segmentation, personalization, automation, and testing strategies that increase relevance and engagement.
Analyze market trends, member insights, and competitive performance to identify growth opportunities and enhance the digital member experience.
Partner cross‑functionally with internal teams and external vendors to ensure alignment, efficient execution, and the successful rollout of new or enhanced products.
As a senior‑level team member, provide guidance to marketing team members and act as a “go‑to” resource for digital marketing strategy and execution.
Identify opportunities to enhance the member experience by refining processes, communications, and/or delivery methods that support product and service adoption or engagement.
Provides service that aligns with the Credit Union’s mission of delivering timely, relevant products, services, and information aimed at increasing adoption and engagement.
Perform other duties as assigned
Must comply with applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to, the Bank Secrecy Act, the Patriot Act, and laws enforced by the Office of Foreign Assets Control.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Apply Now for Consideration!

Qualifications

Proven success driving measurable growth outcomes (acquisition, conversion, retention, cross-sell, engagement) through digital marketing in a data-driven environment
Experience in financial services marketing preferred.
Strong background using performance analytics and KPIs (e.g., conversion rate, CTR, CPA, engagement metrics) to inform decisions and guide continuous improvement.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and optimization roadmaps.

Experience partnering closely with Product Marketing, agency partners, and cross‑functional teams (e.g., product, digital banking, analytics, technology) to deliver aligned and effective go‑to‑market execution.

jobs.description:
We are located approximately 20 miles north of Boston and parking is free. We are also accessible by commuter rail on the Newburyport/Rockport line. Come and explore Endicott’s seaside locale where employees are an important part of the bustling campus community!

Please apply today if this opportunity looks like the right fit for you.

Job Summary

Working under general supervision of the Assistant Vice President, Communications & Marketing, the Director of Marketing & Advertising serves as a strategic leader within College Communications & Marketing (CCM) and is a key marketing partner to academic and enrollment leaders across Endicott College. The Director develops integrated marketing and advertising strategies that strengthen Endicott’s market position, increase visibility of its undergraduate and graduate academic offerings, and advance institutional enrollment and auxiliary revenue goals.

The Director will lead Endicott’s overarching advertising strategy across digital and traditional channels, ensuring investments are informed by institutional priorities, market conditions, data, and defined measures of success. Another primary responsibility is establishing the strategic foundation for how the College brings its programs to market, including positioning frameworks, audience strategies, value propositions, and campaign plans across advertising, web, print, digital, recruitment communications, and content.

Working closely with the Brand Manager, Undergraduate Admission, the Director of Admission Communication, and the Assistant Vice President of Graduate Enrollment, the Director will help steward undergraduate and graduate enrollment marketing and lead major marketing initiatives from strategy through implementation and assessment.

About Endicott College

Endicott College is a vibrant community located on Boston’s North Shore, with a beautiful oceanfront campus in Beverly, Massachusetts. We’re known for combining academic excellence with hands-on learning, and we take pride in fostering a supportive environment for both students and employees.

Working at Endicott means joining a close-knit campus community where your contributions matter and where collaboration, creativity, and professional growth are valued.

Benefits

To learn more about our employee benefits click here.

Key Outcomes

30
% of Time:
Integrated Marketing Strategy & Institutional Priorities

Develop and lead annual and long-term marketing strategies that advance College priorities, including enrollment, institutional visibility, engagement, and revenue growth.
Serve as a primary marketing partner to leaders across the College, helping identify marketing opportunities, define audiences and objectives, and determine the appropriate strategies and resources to achieve them.
Translate institutional goals into actionable marketing plans that establish audiences, positioning, messaging, channels, investment, timelines, and measures of success.
Lead marketing strategy for major College initiatives and emerging priorities, bringing together advertising, brand, creative, content, web, social media, and communications as appropriate.
Evaluate marketing requests and opportunities against institutional priorities, audience needs, revenue or enrollment potential, available resources, and expected impact.
Monitor market conditions, audience behavior, competitive activity, and marketing trends to identify opportunities and inform College marketing strategy.

30% of Time: Advertising, Digital Marketing & Performance

Lead Endicott’s advertising strategy across digital and traditional channels, partnering with an external agency on paid search, paid social, and digital display while directly overseeing out-of-home, print, broadcast, and other advertising opportunities.
Manage advertising agencies, media partners, vendors, and other external marketing relationships.
Establish KPIs and reporting frameworks for major campaigns and regularly communicate performance, insights, and recommendations to College leadership and campus partners.
Ensure paid campaigns are supported by strong creative, content, web experiences, and conversion pathways.
Evaluate new advertising channels, partnerships, sponsorships, and promotional opportunities based on audience fit, institutional goals, cost, and expected return.

25% of Time: Enrollment & Academic Program Marketing

Lead integrated marketing strategy supporting undergraduate and graduate enrollment in close partnership with Enrollment Management and academic leadership.
Develop annual undergraduate and graduate marketing plans informed by enrollment goals, priority audiences, market opportunity, program demand, and performance data.
Develop marketing strategies for new and priority academic programs, including audience identification, positioning, value propositions, competitive differentiation, launch strategy, and campaign planning.
Partner with Undergraduate Admission, Graduate Enrollment, academic leaders, and CCM colleagues to align advertising, recruitment communications, web, print, digital, and content around a cohesive prospective-student journey.
Use enrollment and marketing data to identify opportunities and recommend changes to targeting, investment, channels, messaging, creative, and conversion strategies.

15% of Time: Marketing Content, Web & Audience Experience

Continually assess whether Endicott has the content, creative assets, web experiences, and audience pathways necessary to support its marketing priorities.
Partner with CCM’s creative, social, and web teams to identify gaps and establish priorities for new marketing assets.
Partner with CCM’s content, creative, social, video, and photography teams to identify gaps in the College’s marketing asset library and establish priorities for new asset development, with particular attention to priority audiences and programs.
Conduct ongoing audits of Endicott’s marketing and enrollment web presence and recommend new pages, landing pages, content improvements, audience pathways, calls to action, and other enhancements.
Ensure major advertising and marketing initiatives have the content and digital infrastructure necessary to effectively move audiences from awareness to action.
Be an active participant in the life of the College by attending and supporting major events such as Commencement, Homecoming, and other all-hands-on-deck gatherings. As a member of the leadership team, model a strong commitment to community engagement.
Other duties as assigned

Reporting Structure

Reports to the Assistant Vice President of Communications & Marketing.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Supervises the Brand Manager and is responsible for setting priorities, assigning and overseeing work, providing coaching and performance feedback, supporting professional development, conducting performance evaluations, and participating in hiring and onboarding as appropriate.

Core Competencies

Strategic Marketing Leadership

Connects institutional and enrollment priorities, audience insights, market conditions, and data to develop focused, actionable marketing strategies with clear objectives and measures of success.

Consultative Leadership & Partnership

Builds credibility and trust with academic, enrollment, and institutional leaders; asks the right questions to uncover underlying needs and opportunities; and translates complex priorities into effective marketing strategies.

Audience & Market Orientation

Approaches marketing from the perspective of the audience rather than the tactic; uses market research, competitive context, audience behavior, and institutional strengths to inform positioning and strategy.

Data-Informed Decision Making

Establishes meaningful measures of success, evaluates marketing and advertising performance, identifies actionable insights, and uses data to optimize strategy, investment, channels, and creative.

Integrated Thinking

Sees how advertising, brand, web, content, communications, enrollment communications, and the prospective-student journey work together; brings the right people and channels together around a shared strategy.

Strategic Project Leadership

Moves complex initiatives from strategy through execution and assessment; establishes clear objectives, roles, priorities, timelines, and accountability while managing multiple concurrent initiatives effectively.

Influence & Communication

Communicates strategies, recommendations, and performance insights clearly and persuasively; facilitates productive conversations and can build alignment among stakeholders with different priorities and levels of marketing expertise.

Collaborative Leadership

Works effectively within a multidisciplinary environment and values the expertise of brand, creative, content, digital, communications, enrollment, and academic colleagues; provides clear strategic direction without unnecessarily owning every aspect of execution.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field required.
7+ years of progressively responsible experience in marketing, advertising, or integrated marketing
Demonstrated ability to develop comprehensive marketing strategies informed by organizational goals, audience insights, market opportunities, and data.
Significant experience developing and managing advertising campaigns across digital and traditional channels, with strong knowledge of paid media, audience targeting, SEO/SEM, conversion strategy, and campaign optimization.
Experience developing positioning, audience, value proposition, competitive differentiation, and go-to-market frameworks.
Demonstrated ability to establish KPIs, analyze marketing performance, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
Experience managing agencies, media partners, vendors, marketing budgets, and complex cross-functional initiatives.
Strong consultative, interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships across diverse teams and senior leaders.
Ability to work occasional evenings and weekends in support of major College events and institutional priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree preferred
Experience in higher education, enrollment marketing, or another complex, mission-driven organization
Experience marketing multiple programs, products, services, or audience segments with differing goals and customer journeys.
Experience identifying content and creative asset needs and providing strategic direction for video, photography, and other marketing production.
Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and/or enrollment management platforms.
Experience supporting revenue-generating initiatives, events, venues, or other consumer-facing offerings.
Experience supervising, mentoring, or developing marketing professionals.
Familiarity with higher education enrollment trends, prospective student behavior, and the evolving digital marketing landscape.

In compliance with Massachusetts pay transparency law, the annual base salary range for this position is $90,000–$100,000. Similar to our recipes, we recognize that variety is the spice of life, and therefore, our employees also bring their uniqueness and color to our fantastic team. We’re eager to work with humble team players and pragmatic next-level thinkers to innovate on Home Chef’s offerings.

We are looking for a Sr. Associate of Marketing Technology & Automation to support the technology, data, automation, and technical execution capabilities that power our customer lifecycle marketing strategy. In close partnership with the Lifecycle Marketing team, you will help translate marketing strategies and campaign requirements into scalable, technically sound solutions across our marketing technology ecosystem.

You’ll work closely with the Manager of Marketing Technology & Automation in a highly hands-on, technical role focused on building, maintaining, validating, and troubleshooting lifecycle marketing campaigns across email, SMS, and push throughout the customer lifecycle, including leads and activation, retention and loyalty, and re-engagement and winback.

The ideal candidate combines strong marketing automation and tactical execution skills with a deep interest in marketing technology, data, and automation. You are highly detail-oriented and operationally disciplined, comfortable working in marketing technology platforms and thrive on solving technical and executional challenges. You will serve as a technical subject-matter resource for Lifecycle Marketing, helping marketers bring campaigns to life through data, technology, automation, and scalable platform solutions.

Detailed Responsibilities

Campaign Enablement

Partner closely with the Lifecycle Marketing team to translate campaign strategies, briefs, and requirements into executable campaigns, leveraging marketing technology platforms and data solutions as needed.
Develop and troubleshoot complex, multi-step automations and/or journeys, including decision rule logic, wait conditions, data extension targeting, audience filters, re-entry rules, and cross-channel messaging.
Build, edit, and maintain highly dynamic email templates, content modules, and assets using HTML & CSS, as well as AMPscript conditional logic, fallback handling, personalization, loops, and lookups.
Troubleshoot ESP campaign setup and execution issues, escalating more complex technology or data issues as needed.

Data & Audience Operations

Execute day-to-day activities within the CDP to ESP pipeline, including audience creation & segmentation, flow creation, scheduling, testing, and deployment.
Partner with the Lifecycle Marketing team to leverage CDP capabilities with customer data to support targeting, personalization, and lifecycle marketing strategies within the ESP.
Support the ongoing maintenance of segmentation, flows, and other operational assets.
Document technical processes, campaign architecture, platform best practices, and operational workflows to improve team scalability and knowledge sharing.

Technical Quality Assurance & Campaign Validation

You'll lead growth marketing in partnership with our growth engineering lead: you shape what we test and why, and growth engineering builds it and makes it scale. You'll work alongside a team that ships landing pages, data pipelines, and outbound systems in days, AI routines that run every morning, and a BDR team that calls new leads within minutes.

Key responsibilities

Own Rho's growth target for new funded customers and gross profit, and break it into channel goals each owner in the pod can run with.
Build and run the experimentation program: a one-page brief for every idea (audience, channel, copy variants, tracking, and the scale or kill threshold), a shared tracker, and a Friday retro. Ideas ship in days.
Turn ideas from across the company, from the CEO to the sales floor, into experiments that marketing operations and growth engineering can stand up quickly, and own the follow-through.
Design holdouts and incrementality tests that show which channels create new customers, and move the next dollar based on the results.
Own paid strategy across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, and connected TV, including agency partners, with a clear cost-per-funded-customer and payback bar for each channel.
Lift conversion from first click to funded account through landing page and onboarding tests with design and engineering, from comparison tables to one-click email capture.
Shape lifecycle and nurture so every lead gets the right message at the right moment, and approved customers fund and start using Rho.
Partner with Growth BDRs and account executives on lead routing, speed to lead, outbound plays, and which sources turn into customers.
Work with data and marketing operations on attribution, conversion tracking back to ad platforms, and the weekly scorecard the team runs on.
Agentify the growth loop: build and run AI agents and daily routines that pull funnel and CRO data, generate hypotheses, draft variants, and report results, so the team spends its time on judgment, not busywork.

Requirements

5-7+ years in growth or performance marketing, including at least two years leading growth at a B2B, fintech, or high-velocity SaaS company. You can name the numbers you moved.
Revenue-oriented first: funded customers and gross profit are what get you out of bed.
Has run a high-volume experimentation program and kept it both fast and rigorous.
Hands-on experience designing incrementality tests and holdouts, and the ability to explain to a CEO what last-click reporting misses.
Hands on across paid search, paid social, lifecycle email, and outbound; you build a campaign yourself when that's the fastest path.
Comfortable in SQL and modern data and marketing tools.
You build with AI agents yourself (Claude Code or similar). Your first move on a repetitive task is to agentify it, not hire for it.
Leads through influence: you've partnered with engineering as a peer and rallied a cross-functional team around one goal. Experience managing people is a plus.
Comfortable working inside a regulated business: exact disclosures, verified claims, and compliance review as part of the shipping process.
Based in New York City and excited to work in office with the team.

Experience

Skills And Capabilities

Strong commercial orientation, with the ability to connect marketing activity to business outcomes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex investment concepts into clear and compelling messaging.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Sales & Marketing
jobs.description:
About The Wellness Group

The Wellness Group (TWG) is a diversified healthcare holding company committed to transforming how care is delivered, managed, and experienced. Across our portfolio of companies, we build and scale innovative healthcare businesses: from care management and pharmacy services to wellness technology. We hire people who are mission driven, operationally sharp, and ready to do meaningful work.

About the Company

This role sits within one of TWG’s fast growing healthcare services companies, built to support patients in the space between the doctor’s visit and real life. Our clinical team pairs smart technology with real human connection, so patients get consistent support between visits. The company is scaling quickly in Dallas Fort Worth and nationally, and needs a commercial leader who can turn that momentum into predictable growth. Additional details about the company will be shared with qualified candidates.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales and Marketing to own how the company finds, educates, and enrolls the patients and partners who need us. You will lead the field and community sales team, build the marketing engine that feeds patient enrollment, and turn provider, senior living, and community relationships into a repeatable growth channel. This is a builder role: you will set the strategy, hire and coach the team, choose the tools, and own the numbers.

You will not inherit a playbook. You will write it, and every enrollment it produces is a patient who gets care that would otherwise slip through the cracks.

Key Responsibilities

Build and execute the company’s sales and marketing strategy, with clear enrollment, revenue, and partner growth targets for the DFW market and each new market we enter.
Lead, hire, and coach the field sales organization, setting territories, goals, and a disciplined weekly operating cadence.
Develop and grow referral partnerships with physician practices, health systems, senior living communities, skilled nursing facilities, and community organizations.
Own demand generation across community, event, digital, and partner channels, delivering qualified leads that convert to enrolled patients.
Partner with operations and patient engagement leaders to align lead flow, messaging, handoffs, and conversion metrics from first touch to enrolled patient.
Build the brand and message, including seminar content, collateral, website, and campaigns that explain our services in plain language to patients, families, and providers.
Ensure all sales and marketing activity complies with Medicare program rules, HIPAA, TCPA, and federal and Texas anti kickback and patient solicitation laws, working hand in hand with Compliance and Legal.
Design and manage sales incentive plans that reward quality enrollments and patient retention, with review and approval by Finance and Legal.
Build pipeline reporting and dashboards in the CRM, and deliver accurate forecasts and performance updates to company and TWG leadership.
Manage the sales and marketing budget, vendors, and agencies with a sharp focus on cost per enrollment and return on spend.
Identify expansion markets and new partner channels as the company scales nationally.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, healthcare administration, or a related field (required)
; MBA or MHA a plus.
10+ years of progressive sales and marketing experience, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and field based representatives (required)
.
Healthcare services experience strongly preferred, ideally in chronic care management, remote patient monitoring, home health, hospice, senior living, Medicare Advantage, or value based care.
Working knowledge of the compliance rules that govern healthcare sales and marketing, including Medicare marketing guidance, HIPAA, TCPA, and anti kickback laws.
A proven record of building referral partnerships with physician practices and senior care organizations that produce consistent volume.
Hands on command of CRM and marketing automation platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and the discipline to keep data clean.
Strong analytical skills: you know your funnel, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and forecast, and you can explain all of it in two minutes.
Excellent communication skills; you are as credible presenting to a room of seniors in the morning as you are pitching a health system executive in the afternoon.
Willingness to travel locally across DFW every week and periodically to new markets.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

You thrive in a build stage company where the systems do not exist yet and you get to create them.
You get energy from being in the field with your team, not just reading their reports.
You believe growth and compliance go together, and you would never trade one for the other.
You want your success measured by patients served as much as by revenue booked.

Compensation & Benefits

Performance incentive tied to enrollment and growth goals
Employee health, dental, and vision paid 100% by the company; dependent coverage at 50%

A mission driven environment where your work truly matters

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. Marketing Operations is where that execution lives. This role exists to ensure that every dollar of marketing spend, every campaign, every event, and every account-based program translates into pipeline with zero friction. That requires a system built for precision where the right prospect reaches the right person at the right time, consistently and by design.
You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.
In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high-performing whole.
What You'll Own

Account-Based Marketing Orchestration:

Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest-impact contributions this role makes to the business.

Marketing Technology Foundation:

Own the day-to-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.

Agentic AI Workflow Engineering:

Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.

Enrichment and Insights:

Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first-party behavioral signals, third-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.

System Documentation and Enablement:

Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self-sufficient, building self-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.

Who You Are

You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.
You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. You approach your work with that accountability in mind.
You are technically strong and collaborative by nature. Marketers, Sales and RevOps are close partners. You understand their workflows well enough to anticipate where system gaps will affect their work, and communicate clearly when something is broken, when it is fixed, and why. Strong cross-functional relationships are central to this role.
You see the work through to completion. You build, test, document, and close the loop. When something you own regresses, you identify it first.
What We're Looking For

Required
3 to 5 years in B2B SaaS Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a systems-adjacent role
Hands-on marketing automation and CRM administration, including configuring and maintaining MAP-to-CRM syncs
Demonstrated ability to build and deploy an automated workflow that calls external APIs, whether webhooks, REST APIs, or LLM endpoints, in a production environment
Native fluency in B2B funnel mechanics: MQL definitions, lifecycle stage transitions, opportunity lifecycles, and attribution models
Experience coaching or enabling non-technical stakeholders on new tools, AI workflows, or self-service reporting

Strong Signal
Hands-on administrative experience with intent data platforms, routing engines, and ABM orchestration
Prior experience building LLM-powered workflows for lead scoring, routing, or qualification
Comfort reading and writing JSON, working with REST APIs, and debugging integration errors independently

How We'll Measure Success

The through-line across all of it is pipeline efficiency: more of the right prospects converting into pipeline from the programs already running, with less manual intervention and less fallout.
30 days: Full audit of marketing automation-to-CRM field mapping is complete, ownership of inbound routing rules is established, and current ABM workflow patterns are mapped to identify key automation opportunities.
60 days: First agentic AI workflow is deployed to staging or production. At least one major ABM orchestration sequence that previously required manual steps is automated. An initial self-service enablement resource or dashboard is delivered to the marketing team.
90 days and beyond: Lead sync exception rate is at target with a monitoring process that catches regressions before Sales does. ABM orchestration operates as a reliable service layer that campaign and field marketers can brief and trust to execute. Marketing colleagues actively leverage self-service tools and AI workflows independently.
Application Question

Required with your resume (200 words max):

A high-intent prospect submits a demo request but never reaches the assigned SDR in the CRM. Walk us through your exact diagnostic process: which logs you check first, how you trace the break across the marketing automation-to-CRM sync and inbound routing rules, how you validate the fix, and how you would design an agentic step to evaluate the prospect's form submission notes for priority routing.

Engagement Type:
W-2 Contract with benefits (Health, Dental, Vision, PTO)

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a seasoned Senior CRM & Email Marketing Manager
to support a high-volume, sophisticated email marketing program for a leading consumer technology brand during its busiest season.
This individual will work as an embedded member of the client’s CRM organization, partnering closely with client project managers, analysts, email operations, product stakeholders, CRM leadership, creative teams, legal, development, and other cross-functional partners.
This is not a high-level CRM strategy role
. The focus is on email campaign activation and execution
.

You will take campaigns already mapped to the seasonal CRM roadmap and own the work required to bring them to market—from campaign briefing and creative development through requirements documentation, personalization and versioning, deployment readiness, reporting, and ongoing optimization.
The environment is fast-paced and high-volume. Millions of customers receive multiple communications each week, and individual campaigns may contain several audience, behavioral, or content variations. The ideal candidate brings deep CRM and email marketing experience, strong technical fluency, exceptional attention to detail, and the senior-level judgment necessary to quickly operate within a complex client environment.

What You’ll Do

Own the activation and execution of complex CRM and email campaigns from initial brief through launch and optimization.
Develop detailed email campaign briefs and supporting documentation.
Lead creative kickoffs with agency teams for net-new email campaigns.
Manage creative updates and enhancements to existing campaigns.
Translate campaign objectives into clear, detailed requirements for email operations teams.
Manage sophisticated audience segmentation, behavioral targeting, personalization, dynamic content, and campaign versioning.
Support highly personalized email campaigns leveraging Braze and Movable Ink
.
Work closely with email operations teams to ensure audience logic, content variations, campaign requirements, and personalization rules are clearly defined.
Coordinate campaigns across creative, development, product, legal, analytics, operations, project management, and CRM stakeholders.
Maintain a clear understanding of campaign status, dependencies, approvals, risks, and next steps.
Participate actively in client meetings and serve as a responsive, knowledgeable partner to CRM leadership.
Quickly develop a strong understanding of the client’s products, customer segments, seasonal roadmap, and work-in-progress stages.
Review campaign reporting and performance data.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and make informed optimization recommendations.
Manage multiple concurrent campaigns while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Proactively identify issues, ask questions, and keep work moving in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Bring

Approximately 10+ years of progressive experience
across CRM, email marketing, lifecycle marketing, digital campaign activation, or closely related work.
Significant experience managing complex, high-volume email marketing programs
.
Deep understanding of the end-to-end email campaign lifecycle, including briefing, creative development, campaign requirements, audience segmentation, deployment readiness, reporting, and optimization.
Strong experience with Braze and/or Movable Ink is highly valued
.
Strong understanding of dynamic content, personalization, behavioral segmentation, audience logic, and campaign versioning
.
Experience translating marketing objectives into detailed campaign requirements for email operations and technical teams.
Experience managing multiple audience segments and numerous creative or behavioral variations within a single campaign.
Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Experience working directly with senior marketing and CRM stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across creative, analytics, product, operations, development, legal, and marketing teams.
Strong understanding of email campaign measurement and the ability to translate reporting into actionable optimization recommendations.
Ability to quickly understand complex products, customer journeys, campaign ecosystems, and existing workflows.
Ability to manage significant campaign volume without sacrificing quality or attention to detail.
A proactive, responsive working style with the confidence to actively engage in meetings and drive work forward.
Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with tight timelines and changing priorities.
Agency experience is strongly beneficial.

Ideal Background

We are especially interested in candidates who have spent meaningful portions of their careers managing sophisticated CRM and email programs within large enterprise or agency environments
.

Strong candidates may have held titles such as:
Senior Email Marketing Manager, Senior CRM Manager, Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, CRM Campaign Manager, Associate Director of CRM, Associate Director of Email Marketing, Director of CRM, or Director of Lifecycle Marketing.

This opportunity is best suited for an experienced professional who has remained close to campaign execution and understands the operational and technical complexity required to successfully activate personalized email programs at scale.

The Environment

This is a particularly sophisticated CRM program.
Millions of customers may receive two to three email communications each week
, and campaigns can include four to five behavioral or audience-specific versions
.
Campaigns are highly personalized and may leverage technologies such as Braze and Movable Ink
to deliver dynamic content and differentiated customer experiences.

Success in this environment requires someone who can quickly understand segmentation and versioning, maintain clarity on work-in-progress, participate confidently in client conversations, and remain highly responsive as campaigns move through execution.
You will work directly with senior CRM leadership, so the ability to ramp quickly, lean in, ask smart questions, understand the product, and take ownership of the work
will be essential.

Engagement Details

Approximately November 1, 2026 – April 30, 2027

40 hours per week

Fully remote
Pacific Time business-hour availability is mandatory

$50–$65/hour DOE

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior CRM and email marketing professional who enjoys complex campaign execution, sophisticated personalization, high-volume environments, and working closely with both client and agency teams.

Position Specifics:

This position is primarily field-based, requiring daily travel within an assigned territory to visit retailers, monitor inventory, deliver materials, and provide training. The role involves analyzing sales data, resolving retailer issues, promoting products, and identifying opportunities for business growth. The employee works independently while maintaining regular communication with management and completing reporting and compliance requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

Preferred candidates will have a bachelor’s degree and several years of experience in outside sales, route sales, or territory management, particularly working with retail or convenience store environments. Strong relationship-building, data analysis, and problem-solving skills are essential, along with the ability to work independently and meet sales goals. Experience in field marketing, merchandising, or account management is highly desirable.

The mission of the Department of Finance and Administration is to provide Arkansas citizens convenient, effective, and courteous service which will encourage voluntary compliance with tax, license, and child support laws.

Position Information

Job Series:
Lottery

Classification:
OAL Marketing Sales Rep – Career Path

Class Code:
LLO25P

Pay Grade:
SGS05

Salary Range:
$47,397 - $70,148

Job Summary

The Marketing and Sales Representative (MSR) will promote and sell OAL lottery products. This position is responsible for overseeing a designated field territory, ensuring consistent and continuous service to our retailers. The MSR will act as the primary customer service and account representative, serving as the main point of contact between retailers and the OAL. In this role, the MSR will train retailers on the lottery games and address any complaints or issues that may arise between retailers and customers. Additionally, the MSR will work to secure new business and ensure that new license applications are completed. The MSR will also collaborate closely with vendor partners to maintain the ongoing workflow of OAL as needed.

Primary Responsibilities

Serves as a customer service representative and liaison for ASL within an assigned territory. Identifies route requirements and retailer needs, analyzes ticket usage to determine current demands, and coordinates the placement of ASL promotional materials and supplies. Travels extensively to vendors and retailers to deliver promotional material, provide training, and offer other necessary services. Utilizes a system to deliver and track tickets, reconciles ticket usage with inventory, adjusts inventory levels, and reallocates tickets to other retailers as needed. Ensures proper activation for financial accountability and billing purposes. Analyzes store layouts to recommend the most effective placement of point-of-sale and promotional items. Instructs retailers on strategies to increase sales, motivates them to promote ASL products, and suggests suitable promotional strategies or programs. Recruits and secures new retailers, ensuring the completion and compliance of licensing applications. Trains both new and existing retailers on instant games, other ASL games, and the operation of Lottery validation equipment. Maintains retailer centers to ensure they are presentable and serve as effective sales tools. Identifies retailer issues and plans appropriate actions to resolve them, ensuring the rapid delivery of special ticket orders to retailers. Ensures compliance with ASL rules and regulations. Completes accounting, security, and sales reports, and meets regularly with the assigned Regional Sales Manager to provide updates and information.

Knowledge And Skills

Skilled in negotiating and resolving conflicts while maintaining positive working relationships.

Ability to analyze sales data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.

Familiarity with marketing strategies, promotional campaigns, and brand management.

A strong customer service mindset with the ability to respond to retailer and customer needs in a professional and timely manner.

Experience in dedicated sales route management or direct customer interaction is a plus.

Strong verbal and written communication skills are necessary.

The ability to work independently without direct supervision.

Effective Time Management And Organizational Skills Are Essential.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and basic office equipment (printers, copiers, fax machines).

Minimum Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree is preferable, but a high school diploma plus 3 years of sales or customer service experience can be substituted.

Special Dimensions:

Valid Driver’s License.
Ability and willingness to travel, lift, carry, and transport ASL/retailer materials as needed.
Eligibility for Bonding

Licensure/Certifications

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Marketing Specialist

HydroJug — Brand Marketing
Location: Ogden, UT
Reports to: VP of Marketing
Team: Brand Marketing

ABOUT HYDROJUG

HydroJug built a category and a community around hydration as a daily ritual. Our marketing team is the customer — they know the brands, the gyms, the creators, the moments. That insider fluency is why the work lands. We're expanding into new categories and new consumer segments, and we need that same engine running on the new side of the house.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

You won't be coordinating launches for a community you study. You'll be coordinating launches for communities you're already part of. Our existing marketing works because the team lives in the world it markets to — same gyms, same feeds, same creators. The new category will only work the same way: with someone whose network is already in the spaces we're entering, who can tell us which podcast just blew up before the rest of the internet catches on, and who knows which brands are doing the most interesting work in lifting, hybrid athletics, run, hunt and outdoor, combat sport, and performance wellness. This is a specialist role on purpose. You'll own a compressed version of what a much larger team owns on our established side — seeding and influencer first, brand partnerships second, then events, content, and the rest as the program scales.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN (IN PRIORITY SEQUENCE)

Priority 1 — Product seeding & influencer relationships (first 90 days)
Build the PR list for the new category from scratch — tiered by network economy, not follower count.
Run all four customization tiers (generic → one-of-one) against the right recipients.
Own the seed → follow-up → track → convert workflow for every send. No charitable donations.
Open warm channels with creators across our priority spaces: lifting and hybrid, run, outdoor and hunt, combat sport, and performance wellness.

Priority 2 — Brand partnerships (months 3–6)
Identify the brand counterparts that fit alongside our existing partnership portfolio in these spaces.
Open conversations with the operators (not the agencies) at those brands.
Build the institutional seeding lane — gyms, teams, races, schools — where attention concentrates in these communities.

Priority 3 — Events, content, and adjacent motions (months 6+)
Stand up the event calendar in coordination with the Events Coordinator.
Brief UGC and Social on what reads as native in these spaces — what to do and what not to do.
Become the in-house translator: every team that touches the new category comes to you first.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The non-negotiable credential is demonstrated immersion in and access to the communities
and culture surrounding the spaces above. That shows up as:
An active, real network of creators, athletes, and brand operators in those spaces — the kind where DMs get answered the same day.
Lived participation in at least one (ideally more) of our target spaces: lifting, hybrid and HYROX, run, hunt and outdoor, combat sport, or performance wellness.
Fluent reads on the brand landscape in these categories — you can name the five brands doing the best work right now and the three about to break.
A track record of putting product in the right hands or building programs that earned attention from these communities. What "experience" looks like is flexible. 2–4 years in influencer, partnerships, brand, or creator-side work is typical. We care more about your network and judgment than your title history.

OPERATING STYLE WE HIRE FOR

You run on calendar discipline. A missed send is cheaper than a bad send.
You build relationships, not contact lists. The litmus test is whether the recipient stays if a competitor offers 20% more.
You customize. Generic PR boxes are the floor we're trying to clear.
You track conversion, not volume. Seeds earn relationships, not impressions.
You're opinionated and you write it down.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

VP of Marketing (direct manager), Influencer Manager, Strategic Brand Partnerships, Social, UGC, Events, Retention, Performance Marketing, and the Product team driving the new-category launches.

HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

Active PR list size and tier mix in the new category
Conversion rate of seeds → ambassador, earned content, or partnership
Cost per earned impression in the new category
Brand-partner pipeline opened and activated
Quality of cross-functional collaboration (named, not surveyed)
