new_jobs.description:
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.

Job title: Director, North America partner and field marketing

Company Overview

8x8, Inc. (NASDAQ: EGHT) believes that CX limits were meant to be shattered. We connect people and organizations through seamless communication on the industry's most integrated platform for customer experience, combining Contact Center, Unified Communications, and CPaaS APIs. The 8x8® Platform for CX integrates AI at every level to enable personalized customer journeys, drive operational excellence and insights, and facilitate team collaboration.

Learn more at 8x8.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, and Instagram.

Location:
Remote, United States

Position type:
Full-time

Experience:
7+ years in partner, channel, and field marketing, including experience leading a team.

Role Description

Channel is at the heart of 8x8. Our partner values are relationships, readiness, and revenue, and North America is the largest source of partner revenue. The Director, North America partner and field marketing owns the strategy, budget, and execution for partner marketing, regional field marketing, and 8x8's major industry tradeshows across the region.

You will lead a team of channel marketing and field marketing managers, working hand in hand with sales, channel, and demand generation leaders. You will turn partner and field programs into measurable pipeline and bookings, and make 8x8 the easiest partner to sell with. You are a hands-on strategic leader who sets direction, develops people, and holds programs to clear revenue goals.

Responsibilities

Own the North America partner and field marketing strategy, annual plan, and budget, aligned to the regional go-to-market plan and pipeline targets.
Lead and develop a team of channel marketing managers, field marketing managers, and contractors. Own priorities, performance management, and team structure.
Build and manage marketing relationships with strategic partners, including technology solution distributors (TSDs), agents, resellers, and system integrators. Create joint marketing plans that drive demand and incremental revenue.
Drive programs that recover and grow TSD pipeline, increase partner-sourced pipeline, and recruit new partners.
Own the strategy and execution for all major North America industry tradeshows and conferences, including event selection, sponsorship negotiation, budget, booth and meeting strategy, speaking opportunities, pre-event promotion, and post-event follow-up.
Set clear ROI goals for every event. Measure pipeline, bookings, and cost per opportunity, and shift investment to what works.
Lead regional field marketing, including integrated campaigns, executive events, roadshows, and account-based programs that create net-new opportunities and accelerate existing ones.
Manage the market development funds (MDF) program and planning process. Keep partner investments tied to results.
Partner with channel sales, field sales, and BDR leaders to align activation plans to sales outcomes.
Work with demand generation, content, product marketing, and brand teams so partner and field campaigns share consistent messaging and the customer is the hero.
Run partner enablement and communication, including campaign toolkits, the PartnerXchange portal, webinars, and partner meetings.
Report on performance, budget, and ROI to marketing and executive leadership on a regular cadence.
Use AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, insight, and collaboration across the team.

Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field.
7+ years in partner, channel, or field marketing, preferably in SaaS, telecom, or the IT channel, including experience leading a team.
Proven results running tradeshow and event programs at scale, including major industry events and sponsorships.
Experience in the telecommunications industry, with direct experience working with technology solution distributors (TSDs) to build programs, drive partner-sourced pipeline, and grow revenue.
Experience working with agents, resellers, and MSP or SI partners.
Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, the buyer's journey, and the channel business model.
Strong financial skills, including budget ownership, MDF management, and ROI analysis.
Metric-driven, with the ability to draw insight from complex marketing data.
Proficiency with Salesforce, Marketo, and Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to work with executives, sales leaders, and partners.
Strategic, positive, and energetic, with a fail-fast mindset and a strong work ethic.
Ability to travel up to 30% for tradeshows, partner meetings, and field events.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Events Manager
new_jobs.description:
Engineering moves at software speed. Manufacturing doesn't. Yet.

Machina Labs is changing that. We build intelligent, software-defined factories that produce complex metal structures directly from digital design. By integrating advanced metal forming, robotics, and automated production inside a flexible factory architecture, we enable customers to move from prototype to production in weeks, not years.

Backed by Lockheed Martin, Toyota, and NVIDIA, we're building the manufacturing infrastructure that defense, aerospace, and advanced mobility programs will run on.

If you want to work on hard problems that matter and see them fly, drive, and defend, this is the place.

Job Description

Most companies bring banners and brochures to events. We have robots, factories, vehicles, and precision-formed metal. We want someone who knows what to do with them.

This is a unique opportunity to turn the physical world of Machina Labs into unforgettable experiences. Bring customers into our factories. Bring our factories to customers. Create product launches, demonstrations, and activations that make people see what's possible when you rethink how things are made.

We're looking for a creative builder who sees a factory floor as a showroom, a robot as a centerpiece, and a formed piece of metal as an opportunity to tell a story. Someone equally comfortable imagining an ambitious activation and figuring out how to get a vehicle, missile, or industrial robot onto a show floor.

This is not a conventional events role. You'll work in complex, high-friction environments where engineering, production, logistics, and compliance all matter. The right person is resourceful, organized, creatively ambitious, and relentlessly focused on business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own strategy and execution for all field marketing activities including factory tours, trade shows, guerrilla marketing, partner events, product launches, community days, VIP experiences, and original activations
Transform Machina's factories, products, and manufacturing technologies into compelling physical experiences, both onsite and in the field
Build out our factory showroom and create repeatable experiences that bring customers, partners, and decision-makers into the world of Machina Labs
Develop distinctive activations tailored to the audiences and business objectives of our defense and automotive businesses from technical experts and program leaders to senior executives
Serve as a creative and operational linchpin across marketing, collaborating with brand, content, communications, PR, social, and digital teams to bring integrated campaigns to life
Partner closely with BD and Executive Leadership to turn factory visits, demonstrations, and field experiences into a scalable engine for customer engagement and business development
Build, lead, and scale an events organization, including external production partners, vendors, and contractors
Collaborate with production, engineering, facilities, and compliance teams to execute ambitious experiences without compromising safety, operational priorities, or regulatory requirements
Extend beyond events to support adjacent marketing initiatives, including digital growth, community building, and partner marketing

Required Background & Experience

8+ years of field or experiential marketing experience in high-growth technology, manufacturing, automotive, defense, or similarly complex industries
Proven track record of creating memorable in-person experiences and building the processes and capabilities to scale them as a company grows
Strong personal point of view on experiential marketing. Doesn't simply execute a brief, but observes what resonates with target audiences and continuously improves the experience
Demonstrated ability to build trust and deliver results with cross-functional teams, external partners, and customers
Comfortable navigating complex physical environments, demanding logistics, competing priorities, and unexpected challenges
Resourceful with budgets and unwilling to accept industry norms around expensive, forgettable events. Finds creative ways to use the company's own products, people, and capabilities to achieve greater impact
Equally comfortable setting the strategy, managing the details, and rolling up their sleeves to make something happen

Preferred Qualifications

Background in robotics, AI, defense, automotive, advanced manufacturing, or industrial technology
Experience leading activations for complex B2B and B2G audiences, including enterprise and government buying processes
Experience producing large-scale product demonstrations, factory experiences, or events involving complex hardware and equipment
Los Angeles based preferred, or able to travel regularly for events, activations, and product launches (approximately 25%)

$110,000 - $140,000 a year

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.

In addition to the provided base salary range, comprehensive benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision), PTO, and Stock Options.

new_jobs.title: Global Product Marketing Lead
new_jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

On the Waymo Marketing team, you will help to connect people with the magic and impact of Waymo's autonomous driving technology. Our team has the unique opportunity to not only grow Waymo's brand from the ground up, but to also build societal acceptance for autonomous driving technology for the first time in history. We build thoughtful marketing strategy, positioning, messaging and creative assets to deliver messages that matter to our audience, communicated through anything from video content, to social media interactions, to immersive physical experiences. We also shape Waymo's go-to-market initiatives, helping to transform Waymo into a thriving business with a growing user base.

In this hybrid role, you will report to our Head of Marketing.

You Will

Set the vision, strategy, and priorities for Product Marketing, ensuring the customer and market perspective informs Waymo’s product strategy, go-to-market decisions, and rider experience.
Serve as a strategic partner to Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership, influencing roadmaps, business priorities, and key decisions while driving alignment across teams.
Develop holistic marketing strategies for Waymo’s ride-hailing product and beyond, from positioning and launch through adoption and growth.
Lead product marketing for U.S. and international market launches, expansions, and ongoing market health, integrating consumer, brand, business, competitive, and product signals to identify opportunities and guide market priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing global Product Marketing team, fostering strong strategic thinking, execution, and collaboration to support Waymo’s rapid growth and evolving needs.

You Have

15+ years of product marketing or related marketing experience within consumer technology, including significant experience leading Product Marketing teams and complex consumer products or services.
Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing Product Marketing teams, setting a clear vision and priorities while fostering strong strategic thinking, execution, and cross-functional collaboration.
Deep experience partnering with Product leadership and influencing product strategy and roadmaps, bringing customer, market, and business perspectives into product development and key decisions.
Experience leading U.S. and international market launches and expansions, with the ability to synthesize consumer, brand, competitive, product, and business insights to inform market priorities.
Exceptional strategic judgment and executive influence, with the ability to navigate complexity, develop clear recommendations, and align senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Operations, and other functions.

We Prefer

Experience at a ride-hailing, marketplace, or app-based B2C company.
Concrete marketing experience driving the adoption of emerging technologies or new consumer behaviors, particularly where building understanding and trust is critical.
Track record across both established and early-stage products or markets.
Ability to balance long-term strategic thinking with near-term execution as business and product needs evolve.

Travel

Occasional travel to markets for research, and some travel for offsite meetings, approximately 10% of the time.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$249,000—$307,000 USD

new_jobs.title: Customer Marketing Lead
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

We are looking for a talented Customer Marketing Lead
to apply broad and deep knowledge of ARC, its solutions, customers, and the global air travel industry to develop and manage product positioning, value propositions, target-market definitions, differentiated messaging, and customer marketing plans aligned with ARC’s broader marketing and communications strategy. You will conduct market research and collaborate across functions to define market segments. You will partner closely with Marketing and Communications, Product Management, and Sales to create product messaging, marketing plans, and sales and buyer enablement assets. You will lead initiatives and support peer-led efforts as needed, with teamwork essential to success. You will lead key customer engagement programs, including customer advocacy and win-loss research, requiring frequent customer interaction and strong communication and interpersonal skills. You will present findings and recommendations to leadership.

What You'll Get To Do

Conduct internal and external research to define customer needs and ensure they’re met with appropriate marketing content. Provide informational insights regarding customers, markets, and competitors to measure performance and support product development.
Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and ARC partners to align customer marketing initiatives with business objectives.
Communicate regularly with customers to complete research and gain insight, including working group participation, webinar support and win/loss.
Own development of product positioning documents, value propositions, marketing materials for sales, and more. Coordinate with the broader marketing and communications team, product management and sales to develop marketing programs that drive adoption, engagement, retention and expansion.
Lead customer engagement efforts with the goal of capturing customer interest and needs, product attractiveness/feasibility and testimonials across solutions. This will entail meeting or interviewing key executives at ARC’s travel agency, airline, and other partners.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

4+ years of experience in customer marketing, product marketing or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience considered
Airline, travel agency or corporate travel experience strongly preferred, including knowledge of airline distribution and financial settlement.
Understanding of customer needs, travel data and industry trends and the ability to use these insights to guide marketing strategy.
Ability to develop clear positioning, value propositions and messaging that connect ARC’s products and solutions to customer needs.
Experience developing marketing strategies that support product launches, customer engagement, adoption and retention.
Strong research skills, including the ability to identify customer segments, develop personas and assess market opportunities.
Ability to collaborate across teams and translate product capabilities into meaningful customer benefits.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex workflows, integrations and application programming interfaces in language customers can understand.
Ability to summarize findings, present recommendations and communicate results to senior leaders and executives.

What We Can Offer You

Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, allowing for meaningful future salary growth within the position.

EOE M/F/D/V Females and Minorities Encouraged to Apply

new_jobs.title: Senior Marketing Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Marketing Specialist plans and executes a variety of marketing programs, including trade shows, NHRA race events, marketing collateral, and promotional merchandise initiatives. Working cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners, this role coordinates projects from planning through completion, monitors budgets and results, and ensures activities are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with brand standards and business objectives.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Plans and coordinates trade shows, NHRA race events, sales meetings, customer events, and other marketing activities in collaboration with Marketing, Sales, Product Management, and other business units.
Coordinates event logistics, including venue and hotel arrangements, registration, customer invitations, on-site support, and post-event follow-up.
Supports pre- and post-event marketing activities and evaluates event/program effectiveness, including results, costs, and ROI, to identify opportunities for improvement.
Maintains the annual trade show and event calendar, including key milestones, registration requirements, deadlines, and project status.
Coordinates and maintains event and trade show materials and inventory, including displays, signage, equipment, promotional items, giveaways, and point-of-purchase (POP) materials.
Collaborates with Creative Services and internal stakeholders to develop marketing collateral, including brochures, sales sheets, catalogs, event materials, and other sales and product marketing support materials.
Coordinates with external vendors, including printers, production partners, promotional merchandise suppliers, and other service providers, to ensure materials meet DENSO brand standards, schedules, and budgets.
Supports the management of the promotional merchandise store, including product sourcing, inventory coordination, vendor communication, and ongoing merchandise needs.
Tracks department, project, and event budgets, monitors spending against approved budgets, maintains accurate records, and prepares cost summaries and status reports.
Develops project, event, and marketing updates for Marketing, Sales, Product Management, and other internal stakeholders to support alignment and consistent brand messaging.
Evaluates marketing programs and activities and recommends adjustments to improve effectiveness, efficiency, and business impact.
Stays current on marketing, event, promotional merchandise, industry, and technology trends to identify opportunities to improve marketing execution.
Attends trade shows, NHRA events, customer events, and other company activities as required.
Supports special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

2-5 years of professional experience in a related field.
Demonstrated ability to work independently with moderate guidance and direction.
Experience managing and prioritizing individual workload to meet team and business objectives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess multiple solutions and determine appropriate actions.
Ability to resolve complex, varied, and non-routine issues using established practices and sound judgment.
Working knowledge of industry standards, processes, and best practices within the discipline.
Proven ability to adapt approaches and recommendations based on changing business needs and circumstances.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
Experience serving as a resource and providing guidance to less experienced colleagues.
Commitment to continuous learning and professional development to expand technical and functional expertise.

new_jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
new_jobs.description:
At Arcus, our mission is to empower anyone to build wealth by making investing accessible, affordable, and simple. The team behind Arcus previously built dYdX, helping power over $1.5 trillion in trading volume. Now we're bringing the world's financial markets onchain.

Built in partnership with Robinhood Chain and backed by a direct investment from Robinhood Crypto, Arcus brings crypto, stock tokens, commodities, and perpetual futures into one self-custodied account. Our vision is to build the world's best spot and perpetuals exchange - trusted, accessible, and reliable, with deep liquidity and accurate prices. Every asset, 24/7.

Experienced team: Google, Meta, Citadel, DRW, IMC Trading, Stripe, Coinbase, and more.
Leading backers and advisors: Andreessen Horowitz, Polychain Capital, Brian Armstrong, Fred Ehrsam, Naval Ravikant, Elad Gil, and more.

Join us in shaping the next generation of global financial markets!

→ Learn more about working at Arcus

Role Overview

We're looking for Product Marketing Lead who is also a trader who's also a strong communicator to own how Arcus explains what it ships to its users to generate excitement and engagement.

You turn what engineering builds into communications that traders understand and trust: blog posts, announcements, changelogs, docs, and launch threads. Every product update and incentive change passes through you first.

You're also the product team's best read on what traders actually think. You talk to traders directly, follow what they're saying across the chats, and bring back clear findings that shape product decisions and the roadmap.

This is a hands-on senior role that reports to the CBO and works daily with Product, Engineering, Growth, and Community.

Done well, this role is how Arcus earns trust with every launch. You'll be the voice that makes complex products feel clear, keeps traders confident in what's shipping, and turns real trader feedback into a sharper product for everyone.

Responsibilities

Launches: for every release you write the positioning, the announcement, the blog post, the X thread, and the docs update. You approve launch timing with Engineering so traders hear about a change before it goes live.
Prepare a short brief for each launch so KOLs, BD and regional communities have the right facts and assets.
In product copy: You own and sign off on all user facing copy within the product and app.
Eng to comms pipeline: you run the weekly changelog with Engineering and read it daily. Sensitive changes (fees, liquidations, withdrawals, points, security) get lead time and a reviewed draft. Nothing ships unannounced.
Announcement approvals. You draft, validate internally, and sign off on announcements. You decide what gets said, when, in which channels, and in what order.
Long-form content: use internal data to draft blog posts, product explainers, market-structure pieces and launch narratives that a trader would actually read.
Narrative and positioning: refine differentiation theses and roadmap into credible narrative positioning on why Arcus is different from competitors
Product signal: Talk to traders every day: whales, early contributors, active traders and people who churned. Transmit feedback on fills, listings, fees, UX, competitors, and other signal into structured synthesis for leadership
Get the most out of every partner, starting with Robinhood and the Robinhood Chain ecosystem. Set up co-marketing with each partner, then write and coordinate joint announcements, campaigns and content.
Incident / crisis comms: during rare market or product events, you write what we say, working with Engineering and Community. Community operates the information dissemination; you own the strategy.

Requirements

4+ years in product marketing, content or comms at a crypto-native or trading product, or an equivalent record of shipping launches.
You trade actively. You can explain funding rates, liquidations and fee tiers precisely, because a wrong sentence about them costs trust and money.
You've worked closely with engineers. You can read a changelog or spec, ask the right questions, and turn it into plain language without losing accuracy.
You write clearly and fast, in both long and short form.
You have a network of traders who reply to you and tell you the truth.
Good judgment about tone under pressure: you know when to explain, when to stay quiet, and when an apology makes things worse.

Nice To Haves

Launched products at a perp DEX (decentralized perpetual-futures exchange), a prediction market or a trading venue
Experience with points, rewards or token programs
Knowledge of Asian trader communities (Korea, Greater China)

Gallo Privacy Policy

We are GALLO

We’re a family-owned company with a 90+ year legacy, that’s consistently recognized as a Glassdoor “Best Places to Work.” We have 130+ brands in our total alcohol beverage portfolio including wine, malt, spirits, and ready-to-drink beverages. We’re home to the #1 wine and spirits brands in the U.S. - Barefoot Wine & High Noon and are the official sponsors of the NFL, NHL, UFC, and PGA of America.

View our Corporate Values and Mission Statement here.

Location: Must be willing and able to be based in NYC, NY (Requires 3 days per week onsite)

A Taste of What You’ll Do

Join GALLO as our Senior Manager, Web & Digital Marketing and lead the strategies that shape how consumers discover, engage with, and experience our brands across digital channels. You’ll bring together websites, email/SMS, SEO, CRM, paid media landing pages, and emerging AI-driven search to create connected consumer journeys that drive brand growth and business results.

As a digital marketing subject matter expert, you’ll turn data into action. You’ll lead A/B testing, conversion rate optimization, audience segmentation, analytics, and personalized marketing programs while advancing Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). You’ll partner across brand, MarTech, social, creative, data and insights, PR, paid media, and external agencies to build integrated strategies and continually improve the consumer experience.

You’ll also shape the future of our digital marketing organization. From evolving operating models and assessing readiness for emerging capabilities to managing resources through Agile/Scrum practices, you’ll help ensure our team scales with the business. As a people leader, you’ll coach and develop talent, champion the thoughtful use of AI tools, establish scalable best practices, and create an environment where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning translate into meaningful results.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree plus 8 years of digital and/or e-commerce experience reflecting increasing levels of responsibility; OR Master’s degree plus 6 years of digital and/or e-commerce experience reflecting increasing levels of responsibility; OR High School Diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus 12 years of digital and/or e-commerce experience reflecting increasing levels of responsibility.
Supervisory or managerial experience.
Strong knowledge of contemporary digital media (websites, search, social, content marketing, video, mobile, CRM Strategy).
Proficient in MS Word and MS Excel at an intermediate level.
Proficiency with digital platforms/tools, including but not limited to:
Web content management systems (author/publish, content management, tagging)
CRM/ESP Systems (Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo)
Web analytic tools (Google Analytics, Google Search Console)
Project management tools (AirTable, JIRA)

Strong project management skills with the ability to effectively partner cross-functionally.
Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodology and other project/resource management approaches (e.g., Waterfall, Kanban), with the ability to apply the right method based on team and business needs.
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to drive operational efficiency, accelerate speed-to-market, and support ideation and collaboration.
Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability.
Required to travel by air and automobile up to 25% of the time.
Required to travel to company offices, sites, and/or meeting locations for onboarding, training, meetings, and events for development, department needs, and business delivery up to 5% of the time, with or without reasonable accommodation. This may be in addition to travel requirements, if applicable, as listed in this job description.
Required to be 18 years or older. This may be in addition to other age requirements, if applicable, as listed in this job description.

How You’ll Stand Out

4 years of specific experience in contemporary digital media (websites, search, social, content marketing, video, mobile, CRM Strategy).
Deep understanding of paid media's role in cross-channel digital strategies ensuring a unified consumer journey.
Experience in developing end-to-end customer journeys and designing automated marketing programs leveraging CRM data.
Expertise in managing website strategy to optimize for emerging AI and generative search changes, maintaining organic visibility and user experience.
Expertise in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and generative/AI search strategy, maintaining organic visibility and user experience as brand discoverability and consumer search behavior evolves.

Our Benefits & Perks

To view a full job description, please click here.

We are committed to providing competitive compensation, perks, and a culture that supports your well-being. Benefits depend on your work category and may include medical and dental coverage, 401k plans, profit sharing, pet insurance, company holidays, access to an employee wine shop, and more! This position will be based in the location(s) specified in the job posting with an option for occasional telecommuting. You will be expected to live within a commutable distance.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

We welcome remote candidates based in the continental United States

Merkle is a leading data-driven, technology-enabled, global performance marketing agency that specializes in the delivery of unique, personalized customer experiences across platforms and devices. For more than 30 years, Fortune 1000 companies and leading nonprofit organizations have partnered with Merkle to maximize the value of their customer portfolios. The agency's heritage in data, technology, and analytics forms the foundation for its unmatched skills in understanding consumer insights that drive people-based marketing strategies. Its combined strengths in performance media, customer experience, customer relationship management, loyalty, and enterprise marketing technology drive improved marketing results and competitive advantage.

We are champions for meaningful progress and we strive to be a force for good—for our people, for our clients, for the industry and for our society. We keep our people at the center, creating space for growth, understanding and learning so they can thrive. We embed diversity, in our mindset, in our solutions and in our teams to empower an inclusive, equitable and culturally fluent environment. Building this culture within our teams makes us better collaborators with each other and with our clients, driving better outcomes for all. Merkle is an agency of dentsu.

As Senior Associate, Customer Lifecycle Marketing, you will join a team of talented and experienced marketers who focus on helping Merkle clients achieve their our goals.

You will plan strategy, with a focus on first party data-driven channels (email, SMS, direct mail, push notifications). You will help develop and manage campaign strategies that produce measurable return on investment and you'll work across multiple vertical markets (Insurance, Financial Services, Non-Profit, Retail, Automotive, Travel, Media and Entertainment, B2B, High-tech).

To be successful in this role you need to have a deep passion for finding solutions, and an understanding of how businesses, brands and customers interact,
with an advanced understanding of the always evolving role that data and technology play in this relationship. You know how to identify business growth opportunities and develop recommendations to help group client relationships.

You Will:

Build, develop, and deliver messaging strategy for omni-channel marketing plans using 1st party data.
Be a subject matter expert and be able to translate new technology - focused on areas of messaging and CRM - into new marketing ideas for the client.
Show an understanding of differences in marketing to customers in different industries and environments.
Ensure meaningful client value is delivered through a mix of best-practice solutions, capabilities, and original thinking.
Write campaign briefs to hand off to creative and execution teams.
Collaborate and develop relationships with internal Merkle teams (account management, operations, creative, analytics), and partner agencies to understand the feasibility of cross-channel recommendations/ plans.
Identify main data points and measurements to show the impact of our approach and strategy on our client's business.

You Have:

Bachelor's Degree required
4+ years' experience in data-driven marketing – specifically CRM/ email / direct mail / SMS / push
Hands-on skills using data and research to guide decisions (proficiency in excel maintaining complex spreadsheets and research tools is advantageous)
Experience with client-facing communication (writing and presentations)
Experience translating data analysis into applicable marketing recommendations and presentations – proficiency in PowerPoint (advantageous)
Prior experience incorporating internal and external feedback on an iterative basis.
Experience using business knowledge to identify new business and marketing opportunities.
Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Braze experience (advantageous)
Experience working on several projects simultaneously that are delivered on time, as well as networking and the ability work with a diverse team.
Comfort and experience working within a matrixed organization in roles with a wide degree of latitude.
20-40% travel

The annual salary range for this position is $68,000-$85,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

Benefits available with this position include:

Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
Life insurance,
Short-term and long-term disability insurance,
401k,
Flexible paid time off,
At least 15 paid holidays per year,
Paid sick and safe leave, and
Paid parental leave.

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.

To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps.

Commitment to Mission

At Lone Star College System, every employee contributes to our mission of providing transformational educational opportunities that help individuals get from where they are to where they want to be. Guided by our vision to lead higher education through high-quality, affordable, and innovative learning opportunities, employees are expected to exemplify professionalism, integrity, accountability, and collaboration.

Through our One LSC Philosophy
, we deliver excellent and uniform customer service, providing consistent information, and uniformly helping every student regardless of physical location, modality, college, campus, center, or medium.

This Commitment Supports Lone Star College System's Strategic Goals

Opportunity through financial resilience
Leading in academic excellence
Strength in culture and talent development
Connections through bridges of prosperity

Great Colleges to Work For®

Lone Star College System is proud to be recognized as a Great Colleges to Work For® institution by The Chronicle of Higher Education.
This recognition reflects our commitment to creating an organizational culture where employees are valued, supported, and empowered.

Campus Marketing Statement

Lone Star College-University Center at The Woodlands

Lone Star College-University Center at The Woodlands and University Park

With 100,000 students and counting, Lone Star College System provides transformational educational opportunities that help individuals get from where they are to where they want to be. The two-year institution is training tomorrow's workforce today, offering more than 200 degrees and certification programs that empower students to take the next step.

Lone Star College System has eight main campuses and more than 20 locations in the Houston area. Learn more at LoneStar.edu .

Lone Star College-University Center, located in The Woodlands and LSC-University Park is a partnership with several leading universities to provide bachelor's degrees, master's degrees, and doctorates. Utilizing partnerships and seamless credit transfer programs, the center serves as the critical link for community development and individual opportunities.

The Woodlands address is 3232 College Park Drive, The Woodlands, TX 77384. All applicants must reside in Texas.

The University Park address is 20515 SH 249 (TX 249 and Louetta Road), Houston, TX 77070. All applicants must reside in Texas.

Job Description

PURPOSE AND SCOPE:

The Coordinator III, Marketing and Outreach collaborates with the LSC marketing team at System Office to develop a marketing plan for the LSC-University Centers and coordinates the implementation of the marketing plan. The responsibilities of the position include multiple websites, social media presence, designing of marketing materials (online and printed), and coordinating outreach and public relations events. Attendance at some events is required during heavy orientation and graduation times. Serves as the point of contact for students inquiring about program information and university partners needing outreach support.

Essential Job Functions

Develops and implements integrated marketing strategy for LSC-University Center
Researches and applies new trends to enhance the user experience and increase engagement on all communication platforms
Serve as project coordinator for major marketing events and initiatives through the University Centers
Supports increased offerings of university partner programs through the University Centers as well as collaborates with partners to improve student participation
Coordinate and maintain high inventory flow of marketing and publication materials and promotional items
Creates templates, navigation structures and other graphic elements
Increases website visibility through continuous updates
Coordinates messaging and visual display of all electronic advertising via the on-campus plasma screen messaging system
Prepares illustrations for use in publications, presentations, and the Web by using various graphic design software
Designs publications and page layouts according to aesthetic and branding standards, applies knowledge of layout and computer software
Develops and coordinates communication plan for the outreach and recruitment of students; includes student tracking, email communication, social media, etc.
Collaborate with university partner staff and administrators on outreach, recruitment, admissions, and enrollment opportunities, including attendance at related events. Also assists in hosting University Center events
Responsible for other reasonable, related duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Ability to adapt to a changing environment
Ability to communicate effectively and work with diverse clientele in a team environment
Ability to meet deadlines
Knowledge of digital photography and graphic design skill set
Knowledge of multiple web tools such as HTML, DHTML, JavaScript, Photoshop, Illustrator Adobe software programs and PowerPoint
Knowledge of web and marketing analytic tools
Strong writing, editing, project management, and attention to accuracy skills
Excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to work in a student-centered, team-oriented environment

Physical Abilities

The work is sedentary. Typically, the employee sits comfortably to do the work. However, there may be some walking; standing; bending; carrying of light items, such as papers, books, or small parts; or driving an automobile. No special physical demands are required to perform the work.

Work Schedule And Conditions

Equipment used includes, PC workstation running on a LAN in a Microsoft Windows environment, calculator, phone, and other general office equipment
Interface with internal and external contacts as needed to carry out the functions of the position
Work is performed in a climate-controlled office with minimal exposure to safety hazards

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and at least 1 year of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience must include at least 1 year in marketing

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in public relations, marketing, communications
Experience with web and marketing analytics tools
Experience with website development and mobile usability and responsiveness
Experience in creating email engagement and social media content
Experience working in higher education

Salary

Hiring salary range is $48,152 - $55,375

Lone Star College provides a hiring salary range for all posted full-time non-faculty positions. Where your salary offer would fall in that range is determined by your related experience and education. Should you receive an offer of employment from Lone Star College, the resume submitted in the application process will be utilized to calculate your salary offer. The information outlined below will provide the Office of Human Resources everything needed to determine an accurate starting salary.

Your Resume Should Provide a Complete Picture Of Your Work Experience. The Resume Should Include The Following Information For Each Position Listed

Length of time (specific months and years) of employment
If the position was full time or part time
If the position was paid or unpaid
Level of degree completed including date earned.
Unofficial transcript for highest earned degree

Additionally, any certifications listed as required or preferred in the Lone Star College job description should be included in the resume submitted.

By joining our top-notch institution, you will enjoy being a part of an organization that offers a supportive, collegial work environment and excellent work/life balance. This includes a full comprehensive and competitive benefits package, a generous number of paid holidays and vacation days, wellness programs, tuition waiver, professional development opportunities and more.
